messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 INCIDENT OPEN — High 5xx spike detected at api-gateway-eu-west (502/504). Severity: P1. Pager: @oncall-api. Runbook: https://runbooks/redwood/gateway-5xx. Autoscaling flags show no recent scale events.

oncall-api: On it. Starting triage now. Anyone aware of a deploy around the spike? Sophie / Raj — can you confirm runtime health?

Sophie C: Not from deploy side. Spike starts ~2112345400. Grafana dashboard: https://grafana/redwood/d/abc/api-gateway-5xx?from=now-1h — top of stack shows ingress 502s from edge nodes.

Raj P: Seeing upstream latency growth to inference-gw: p50 1.2s -> p95 12s, connection resets increasing. Pattern consistent with connection pool exhaustion / upstream timeouts.

Miguel R: Suggest short-term mitigation: enable circuit-breaker fallback + route a small % to a cached-response fallback pool. I'll prepare the edge config patch.

oncall-api: Go for it. Applying traffic split 30% -> fallback_pool to reduce pressure on upstream. Command I'm about to run: ```kubectl -n edge patch configmap edge-routing -p '{"data":{"traffic_split":"fallback:30,primary:70"}}'```

ops-bot: Config change applied by oncall-api at 2112345485. traffic_split=30 -> fallback_pool. Health checks re-evaluating.

console-bot: Alert: customer-facing error rate > 1% for top customers (ACME, BetaCorp, Delta). Creating status page incident and notifying CS team.

Sophie C: Noticed KV cache miss rate jumped and eviction spikes on cache-eu nodes. Example log: `WARN kv-cache eviction id=trace-3f2a path=/models/abc reason=mem_pressure trace_id=trx-9a8b` — could be compounding upstream delays.

Raj P: Doing rolling restart on gateway pool gway-eu-01..03 to clear stale connections. Command: ```for p in gway-eu-0{1..3}; do kubectl -n edge rollout restart deploy/$p; done```

oncall-api: Restarts completed at 2112345720. Observed 5xx rate drop ~40% shortly after. Latency improved: p95 down from 12s to ~1.1s but p50 still a bit high (~900ms).

Miguel R: Continued recommendation: increase upstream keepalive pool, bump max idle connections and set upstream timeout to 15s. Filing follow-up RFC/Ticket: INF-2345 (tune upstream connection pooling + cache sizing).

oncall-api: Acknowledged. Creating incident postmortem placeholder and linking runbook. Handover: daytime incident lead -> Sophie C (monitoring & customer comms). If errors re-escalate, Raj P is second on-call. Good work. :white_check_mark:

Customer Success: Status updates sent to ACME and BetaCorp via status page + email. Logged customer tickets and started outreach for any API impacts.

incident-bot: RESOLUTION: 5xx rate returned to baseline. Incident duration ~18 minutes (2112345400 -> 2112346480). Mitigations: traffic_split to fallback_pool, rolling restart of gateway nodes. Tags: gateway, 502, 504, traffic-split, circuit-breaker. Postmortem assigned: INF-2345.
